evidence: decorative_mascot: Data is parked in the same spot hovering over the top two bar rows in hook@0.3, seg0:mid, seg1:start, seg1:mid, seg1:end and seg4:mid — only seg3:start/seg3:mid give him a real bit (a hoop tossed at the 2014 bar), so for most of the runtime he is a floating sticker, not a performe

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg4:start the yellow callout 'The land shrank. Somehow the grain didn't.' is pasted over the top of the chart and completely hides the 1972 row; at seg4:mid the 1972 bar is sliced in half ('554738' clipped) and Data is decapitated — payoff@-1.8, seg4:end and payoff@-0.4 show only his legs and coat hem below the bubble. Worse, the chart under the line is still growing: 1982 589,208,772 → 2014 724,692,671, the largest bar on screen, while the narration claims a collapse. The 415,702,088 figure from the script is never drawn.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing callout is composited at a fixed top-of-frame position over the live chart layer with no reserved lane or bar-row offset, and the cereal series ends at its 2014 peak — the 2024 collapse value is absent from the rendered frames, so the final image asserts the opposite of the closing line.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Extend the cereal series through 2024 so the final bar visibly retracts to 415,702,088 (the shrink should be the motion the payoff lands on), and reposition/resize the closing callout into clear space so it occludes neither the 1972 row nor Data's head — end on the mascot fully visible reacting to the bar pulling back.
